title: Sea Room
blurb: A virtual pet room by the ocean with Sprout, a big soft green pup with a chocolate Lab's heart, and Sage, a round sage-green cat who does what she likes. Turn your phone to look around, call them with your finger or your voice.
controls: Turn the phone (or ⟲ ⟳) to change the view; tap the floor to throw the ball; press and hold the floor to call both pets; tap or rub a pet to fill its heart; 🎤 for voice commands (sit, come, dinner, roll over, good kitty…); Feed and Nap buttons
